```{r}
#| include: true
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "report.R"))
Standard.target <- c("GISTM", "CDA", "ANCOLD")
```

# Tailings Storage Facilities Design Criteria {#sec-criteria}

## Executive Summary {#sec-tsf_summary}

{{< include /_chapters/tailings.summary.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/criteria_summary.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-summary",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-criteria-summary-site",
    context = "resumen de criterios de relaves"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
